auth.heading: Sign in or create an account
auth.errorInvalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Please try again.
auth.legal: By continuing you agree to our {terms} and {privacy}.

onboarding.youSub: Your name, a face and a colour. Anyone who eats with you comes next.
onboarding.familyTitle: Who else is at the table?
onboarding.familySub: Just you is fine. Add anyone who eats with you, a first name or nickname is enough.
onboarding.dinnerTitle: When do you usually eat dinner?
onboarding.dinnerSub: This sets the moment for the daily question. You can change it any time.
onboarding.pingSub: One question around {time}: what did you taste today? Nothing else unless you ask for it.

logTab.title: Log what you tasted
logTab.body: After you've eaten, tap Log and tick the plants you tasted.

plantRow.title: Tap a plant to log it for today
plantRow.body: Every new plant becomes a card in Unlocks, and it levels up as you taste it again.

weekChip.title: 30 different plants a week
weekChip.body: The guideline comes from the American Gut Project (2018): adults eating more than 30 different plants a week had a more varied gut flora. Variety counts, not amounts.

home.logFirstPlantSub: Tap Log and tick what you tasted today.

log.title: Today's plants
log.subtitle: Tap what you tasted today
log.searchPrompt: Search for a plant or pick a category
log.missingBody: Suggest "{query}" and we'll add it if it qualifies.
log.suggestionSentSub: We check it by hand. New plants arrive with an app update, so it can take a few weeks.
log.defaultHint: Your pick becomes the default for the next plants
log.holdHint: Hold a plant to choose who tasted it
log.logEmpty: Add who eats with you first, then log who tasted what.

stats.title: Your stats
stats.perWeekBody: Different plants you logged, Monday to Sunday. The lighter bar is this week.
stats.perDayBody: Different plants logged each day, the last 4 weeks.
stats.empty: Log the first plant and the weeks start filling up here.
stats.mixBody: Share of everything you logged, per category.
stats.typicalNote: Typical is the middle of everyone on Project Food.
stats.dinnersInARowDesc: Days in a row with at least 1 plant logged
stats.weeksAtGoalDesc: Weeks with {n} different plants or more

plant.tapToFlip: Tap the card to flip it
plant.locked: Taste it once to unlock the card

celebration.firstBitesBody: Three plants tasted. That earns the first achievement.
celebration.goldCardBody: {n} tastes. The plant is gold from now on.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.bodyTwice: {n} different plants tasted at least twice

full_table.title: Full table
full_table.body: {n} plants everyone at the table has tasted

rainbow.title: Rainbow
rainbow.body: {n} weeks with 5 colours on the table

herb_garden.title: Herb garden
herb_garden.bodyTwice: {n} herbs & spices tasted at least twice

nutcracker.title: Nutcracker
nutcracker.bodyTwice: {n} nuts & seeds tasted at least twice

grain_train.title: Grain train
grain_train.bodyTwice: {n} whole grains tasted at least twice

tomato_family.title: Tomato family
tomato_family.body: Taste {n} plants of the nightshade family

nice_try.title: Nice try
nice_try.body: 100 plants in one day. A level only counts a plant tasted on 2 different days.

at_the_table.title: At the table
at_the_table.body: Logged within 5 minutes of dinner time

family.title: At your table
family.empty: Add anyone who eats with you.
family.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the table? Their tastes stay in the collection.

account.title: Account
account.deleteBody: This removes your household, its profiles, cards and achievements for good. Your tastes stay only as anonymous statistics, linked to no one. There is no undo.
account.deletedBody: Your household, its profiles, cards and achievements are gone. Your tastes stay only as anonymous statistics, linked to no one. Thank you for having been at the table.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.systemOff: Notifications are off for Project Food on this phone.
notifications.essentialDesc: The daily question, your streak and the Sunday nudge. On by default.
notifications.marketingDesc: Card and achievement teasers and the Sunday nudge. Off by default.

dinnerQuestion.label: Daily question
dinnerQuestion.description: "What did you taste today?" about half an hour after dinner

streakKeeper.label: Streak keeper
streakKeeper.description: Only when your streak is at risk

cardTeaser.label: Card & achievement teasers
cardTeaser.description: After a few quiet days: which card is close. And before dinner, when an achievement passes halfway to its next level

sundayNudge.label: Sunday nudge
sundayNudge.description: When you are a few plants from 30

permissionPrompt.title: Want the daily question?
permissionPrompt.body: One gentle question after dinner, around {time}. Nothing else unless you ask for it.

survey.title: Feedback
survey.consent_body: This survey links your answers to your in-app activity so we can understand how the app is used — anonymously and in aggregate.
survey.consent_label: I'm OK with Project Food matching my answers to my in-app activity.
survey.submitted_body: Your feedback helps us build a better app.
survey.prompt_banner: We have a few questions for you.
survey.new_questions: {count} new questions since your last visit
survey.remove_body: Everything you filled in goes, including your consent. You can start again any time.
